nodes.description: Constant burn address used as the destination for swapped/burned waifu NFTs.
Constant ERC20 token address (WET) charged as the swap fee.
Constant address of the Waifusion NFT contract controlled by this dungeon.
Maximum waifu NFT supply constant (16384) used for mint accounting.
Maximum number of waifus swappable in one commitSwapWaifus call (3).
Mutable ETH price per waifu for commitBuyWaifus; owner-settable.
Mutable WET token price per waifu swap; owner-settable.
Number of waifus currently held in the dungeon; incremented/decremented on deposits and reveals.
Monotonic nonce mixed into the randomness hash during reveal.
Mapping address => Commit(block, amount) tracking pending buy/swap commitments for reveal.
Mapping index => Waifu(nftContract, waifuID) holding all NFTs owned by the dungeon.
Ownable storage slot holding the privileged owner address.
Fallback receive function accepting plain ETH transfers.
ERC721 receiver hook; strictly requires msg.sender == WAIFUSION and operator == this contract before storing the NFT.
Payable entry point that commits an ETH purchase of num waifus and stores the commitment.
Burns caller waifus and pulls WET fee via SafeERC20, then commits the swap.
Reveals committed waifus: performs external NFT safeTransferFrom calls before mutating waifusInDungeon/waifuCount.
Owner-only helper computing how many waifus remain to mint and forwarding to funnelWaifus.
Owner-only function withdrawing ETH from Waifusion and minting num waifus with the proceeds.
Owner-only arbitrary NFT deposit that stores an external NFT in the dungeon mapping.
Owner-only ETH withdrawal sending the whole contract balance to msg.sender via transfer.
Owner-only call pulling funds out of the Waifusion contract.
Owner-only function that transfers ownership of the Waifusion contract to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only setter for the per-waifu ETH buy price.
Owner-only setter for the per-waifu WET swap price.
Internal helper validating num and writing the caller commitment (block, amount) into commits.
Internal helper validating the commitment window, deriving pseudo-random IDs from blockhash and revealNonce, and clearing the commit.
Ownable view returning the current owner stored in _owner.
Ownable owner-only function reassigning _owner to newOwner.
Access-control modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender() before executing privileged functions.
External caller address, used for commitment bookkeeping, refunds, burns and privilege checks.
External ERC20 pull of the WET swap fee from msg.sender to the burn address.
External call burning the caller's waifu NFTs to BURN_ADDR inside the swap loop.
External safeTransferFrom dispatch to the NFT contract which invokes receiver hooks on arbitrary callee contracts.
Native ETH transfer of the full contract balance to msg.sender.
External payable mint call forwarding num * nftPrice ETH to the Waifusion contract.
External call triggering fund withdrawal on the Waifusion contract.
External call transferring ownership of the Waifusion contract to an arbitrary address.
Number of waifus the caller commits to buy; must equal msg.value / buyCost and be <= 20.
Calldata array of waifu token IDs to burn in exchange for committed waifus.
Arbitrary NFT contract address deposited by the owner.
Token ID of the arbitrary NFT deposited by the owner, truncated to uint64 on storage.
New per-waifu ETH price assigned to buyCost.
New per-waifu WET price assigned to swapCost.
Address receiving ownership of the Waifusion contract.
Address receiving ownership of this dungeon contract.
Operator address supplied by the ERC721 transfer, required to equal this contract.
Source address of the incoming ERC721 safe transfer.
Incoming waifu token ID, required to be below MAX_NFT_SUPPLY.
Unused calldata payload forwarded with the ERC721 receiver hook.
Number of waifus the owner requests to mint from the Waifusion contract.
Local derived from _ids.length, bounding the burn loop and the WET fee amount.
Locally computed array of dungeon slots revealed to the caller.
Local computing MAX_NFT_SUPPLY - Waifusion.totalSupply().
Local capped at 20 (or remaining supply) passed into funnelWaifus.
Local snapshot of address(this).balance sent to the owner.
Local copy of block.number stored into the caller commitment.
Local copy of the caller's Commit struct read during reveal.
Local blockhash of the block after commitment, used as randomness entropy.
Local derived index seeded from revealNonce/revealHash and incremented per reveal.
Local cached copy of waifuCount used as the modulo range for random IDs.

edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against WAIFUSION before accepting an incoming NFT.
Caller pays ETH and becomes the commitment owner.
Caller's waifus and WET tokens are pulled for the swap.
Caller's commitment determines which waifus are revealed to them.
Owner-supplied NFTs are transferred from msg.sender into the dungeon.
Full contract balance is transferred to msg.sender.
Caller address keys the commits mapping write.
Caller address keys the commitment lookup and clearing during reveal.
_msgSender() is compared to owner() to gate privileged functions.
onlyOwner modifier guards funnelMaxWaifus.
onlyOwner modifier guards funnelWaifus.
onlyOwner modifier guards addNFTToDungeon.
onlyOwner modifier guards withdraw.
onlyOwner modifier guards withdrawFromWaifusion.
onlyOwner modifier guards setWaifusionOwner.
onlyOwner modifier guards setBuyCost.
onlyOwner modifier guards setSwapCost.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership.
The modifier reads owner() to authorize the caller.
buyCost determines the required msg.value for a buy commitment.
swapCost multiplies amountToSwap to form the WET fee pulled from the caller.
WAIFUSION is both the required msg.sender and the stored nftContract for received waifus.
waifuCount is used as the storage slot for the newly received NFT.
waifuCount bounds the pseudo-random index range during reveal.
revealNonce is mixed into the randomness hash.
The previous commitment block is read to enforce the reveal window.
The caller's commit struct is read to validate and clear the reveal.
waifusInDungeon is read and then rewritten after external NFT transfers, leaving stale state during the callbacks.
owner() returns the privileged address stored in _owner.
Received waifu data is written into waifusInDungeon at index waifuCount.
waifuCount is incremented after accepting an NFT.
The dungeon mapping is mutated (swap-and-pop) only after the external safeTransferFrom loop completes.
waifuCount is decremented after external NFT transfers, so a reentrant call observes an inflated count.
The deposited NFT is appended to waifusInDungeon.
waifuCount is incremented after the deposit.
setBuyCost writes the new ETH price into buyCost.
setSwapCost writes the new WET price into swapCost.
_commitRandomWaifus stores the caller's block and amount into commits.
_revealRandomWaifus zeroes out the caller's commitment.
_revealRandomWaifus increments revealNonce after generating IDs.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged _owner slot.
commitBuyWaifus delegates commitment bookkeeping to _commitRandomWaifus.
commitSwapWaifus delegates commitment bookkeeping to _commitRandomWaifus.
revealWaifus uses _revealRandomWaifus to obtain the slot list.
funnelMaxWaifus calls funnelWaifus with the computed mint amount.
funnelWaifus first withdraws accumulated funds from Waifusion.
funnelWaifus forwards ETH to the external mintNFT call.
The swap flow performs the external WET fee pull.
The swap loop performs external NFT burn transfers.
revealWaifus triggers safeTransferFrom on arbitrary NFT contracts, handing control to untrusted code before state cleanup.
A malicious NFT receiver can re-enter revealWaifus through the ERC721 receiver hook while state is inconsistent.
withdraw pushes the balance out with a native transfer.
withdrawFromWaifusion invokes the external withdraw call.
setWaifusionOwner forwards the ownership transfer to the external contract.
num drives the ETH requirement and commitment size.
_ids determines the NFTs burned in the swap loop.
nftContract selects the external NFT pulled into the dungeon.
nftID is stored (uint64-truncated) as the dungeon waifu identifier.
newBuyCost is written into the buyCost price slot.
newSwapCost is written into the swapCost price slot.
newOwner is forwarded to the Waifusion ownership transfer.
newOwner is assigned to the _owner slot after a zero-address check.
operator must equal address(this) for the incoming NFT to be accepted.
from identifies the source of the incoming ERC721 transfer.
tokenId is range-checked and stored as the dungeon waifu ID.
data is accepted as part of the receiver signature but not used.
num sizes the external mintNFT call and the ETH value forwarded.
amountToSwap scales the WET fee passed to safeTransferFrom.
amountToSwap bounds the burn loop that calls transferFrom.
The locally computed slot list drives the untrusted external safeTransferFrom calls.
remainingWaifus caps the mint amount passed to funnelWaifus.
waifusToMint is the argument forwarded to funnelWaifus.
The captured balance is the value sent in the native transfer.
currentBlock is written into the caller's commitment struct.
The cached commit struct supplies block/amount for the reveal window checks and loop bound.
Randomness depends on a miner-influenceable blockhash, a weak block/timestamp-class entropy source.
randomIndex is the generated destination index written into the returned array.
_waifuCount is the cached modulus used to derive sequential random IDs.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to size the payable commitment inside commitBuyWaifus.
The token ID array is consumed only by the burn loop of commitSwapWaifus.
The NFT contract address is used solely to perform and record the owner deposit.
The token ID is stored exclusively in the dungeon mapping written by addNFTToDungeon.
It is a direct assignment source for the buyCost state variable.
It is a direct assignment source for the swapCost state variable.
It is forwarded unchanged to the external Waifusion ownership transfer.
It is validated and written into the _owner slot by transferOwnership.
It is only used in the receiver-hook validity check.
It is contextual metadata of the receiver hook and never stored.
It is range-checked and converted into the stored waifu ID inside the hook.
It is an unused receiver-hook parameter with no influence beyond the signature.
It sizes the external mintNFT call and forwarded ETH value.
It is a derived local confined to the swap fee and burn loop of commitSwapWaifus.
It is the temporary slot array driving the reveal transfers and cleanup.
It is a local supply computation used only to cap the mint amount.
It is the capped argument passed directly into funnelWaifus.
It is the transient value used for the native transfer in withdraw.
It is a cached block.number stored into the commitment struct.
It is a memory copy of the caller's commitment used for validation and loop bounds.
It is the blockhash entropy input for the random index derivation.
It is a loop-local index written into the returned slot array.
It is a cached waifuCount used as the modulus for random slot generation.
